AddDatabase.title: Connect to a database through DG
AddDatabase.summary: Use this API to connect databases on other clouds or on-premises to Alibaba Cloud.

AddDatabaseList.title: Batch connect databases through DG
AddDatabaseList.summary: Adds multiple databases to a gateway in a batch operation.

CheckDGEnabled.title: Check whether the current user has activated the Database Gateway product
CheckDGEnabled.summary: Checks if Database Gateway (DG) is enabled.

ConnectDatabase.title: Database Connectivity Testing
ConnectDatabase.summary: Call this API to test database connectivity.

CreateGatewayVerifyCode.title: Generate a verification code required for offline gateway installation
CreateGatewayVerifyCode.summary: Generates a verification code to link an on-premises Database Gateway installation to its corresponding gateway in the cloud.

DeleteDatabase.title: Delete Database
DeleteDatabase.summary: Deletes a database from a database gateway.

DeleteGatewayInstance.title: Delete Gateway Edge Zone
DeleteGatewayInstance.summary: Deletes the specified database gateway instance.

DescribeRegions.title: Obtain the regions supported by Database Gateway
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions where you can create database gateways.

DownloadGatewayProgram.title: Obtain the download URL of the gateway program
DownloadGatewayProgram.summary: Retrieves the download URL for the gateway program. Any Alibaba Cloud user can call this operation without requiring permissions.

FindUserGatewayById.title: Obtain the details of a gateway.
FindUserGatewayById.summary: Retrieves the details of a gateway, including the user who created it and the number of running gateway instances.

GetUserDatabases.title: Obtain the database list in the gateway
GetUserDatabases.summary: This API lists the databases in a specified gateway.

GetUserGatewayInstances.title: Obtain detailed information about gateway edge zones
GetUserGatewayInstances.summary: Call this API to get the details of the gateway node.

GetUserGateways.title: Retrieve gateway list
GetUserGateways.summary: Retrieves a list of user-created Database Gateways.

ListDatabaseAccessPoint.title: Obtain the database endpoint list
ListDatabaseAccessPoint.summary: Gets a list of database access points.

ModifyDatabase.title: Modify Database Information
ModifyDatabase.summary: This operation modifies database information, such as its description.

ModifyGateway.title: Modify the basic information of a gateway
ModifyGateway.summary: Call this API to modify the basic information of a gateway, including the gateway name and gateway description.

RetryDatabase.title: Reconnect Database
RetryDatabase.summary: Call this API operation to reconnect a database gateway to a database.
